intelligence.essence: Your Smart Business App is an intelligent home for your business, your work, your services, your products, your customers, and your opportunities. It's designed to help you become discoverable, communicate professionally, organize your work, and earn money from genuine value you provide. Same as your Personal World — same features, same power — built for your business life.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you make the best lemonade on your street, and suddenly you have your very own shop — with your name on it, pictures of your lemonade, and a friendly helper who tells people about it, takes their orders, and keeps everything tidy. That's your Smart Business App: your own shop on the new internet.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine opening a little shop of your own, where everything you know how to do becomes something people can find, enjoy, and pay you fairly for — and a trusted helper who keeps the books, minds the door, and tells the right people you're open. That's what your Business App does for you.
